text: Seven years ago I met this lady at work and we became really good friends for about two years and she was married to a man she had been with since she was a teenager that she had a kid with and they were in a really unhappy marriage. And against my better judgment I pursued her and three months after we started dating we got engaged. I borrowed $15,000 from my mother to put a down payment on a house. I moved Jessica and her son in with me and we all lived as a family and for the first like two years things were pretty good. And she was still married with a kid? Yep. Wait a second. What do you mean she was still married? He said they got engaged. And why? Why the therapist says nothing about? Look man you met a girl at work who was still married to another dude when you started your romance. She was cheating on her husband with you and you decided to get engaged with her and take her kid? How stupid can you be? You should not be a genius to understand that if you be with her she will cheat on you with someone else because that is what she did to her husband. Guys I'm not going to preach morals to you if you meet a girl and find out she has a boyfriend, partner, or husband. It is your choice whether to sleep with her or not. But you should understand that she is most probably not for a serious relationship because if she's cheating on her partner now in the future there is a very high chance she will cheat on you. So now we have three kids and we're all living in the house. For the last year and a half or so Jessica and I have kind of grown apart. There's been like a disconnection in our relationship and originally when I called your show I was going to ask how to reconnect with her but in the pit of my stomach I always had a feeling that something was going on and I found out that she cheated on me with somebody that she was working with. Surprise surprise the history repeats itself. And also with someone who she has been working with. Isn't that logical? And I'm just falling apart John and I don't know what to do. I don't know what to do. I screwed everything up and I don't know what to do. You're right this is a mess. It's a big mess. You found somebody who would love you. Connection makes us do dumb things. He found someone who would love him? Connections make us do stupid things? She doesn't freaking love him man. She cheated on him. Same way she didn't love her husband before this guy. What kind of love we're talking about here? I'm gonna be super honest with you. This is completely full stop over. She's moved on. She's done it before and she's done it to a person who's still her husband. There's probably somebody in between you two. But before you do anything else, before you go down the rabbit hole what I do, you have to sit in it for a second and grieve. Well the start of the advice with the full stop was good but then he went to the rabbit hole of what I do and all this. What? What I do and all this? There's only one right thing to do here and before you do anything you should sit down and grieve? What kind of advice is that? Look I say it many times. Guys don't be freaking drama queens. Yes you screwed up. Yes you made wrong decisions. Fair enough. And it is normal that you feel down, exhausted, devastated. Again that is how it should be. You rip what you saw. Actions have consequences. But at least now you should start acting right. You need to understand that the person you chose was the wrong person. There is no love there. You need to divorce, distance yourself from that person as much as possible and start a new life. Here it would be more difficult as they have kids. So what you need to do is to figure out the situation with kids and only have contact when it is about kids. That's it. No other communication. And then once again you need to start working on yourself. This guy lacks basic understanding of everything. He still thinks that he can repair the relationship. He is ready to forgive this woman thinking that it's going to change anything. No it only will make your life even worse. You do not forgive that. You understand that it was a wrong person in the first place and it is your fault for choosing her as all the signs were there. You understand your mistakes and you start building your life from that point up.
